program_terms.applies_to: all Visa M holders incl. M Inversionista: continuous calendar days abroad within each 365 days from issue, beyond which the visa lapses
program_terms.quote: Las visas de Migrante (M) cuyos titulares se ausenten del país por más de ciento ochenta (180) días calendario continuos, dentro de cada trescientos sesenta y cinco (365) días contados a partir de la expedición de su visa, perderán automáticamente su vigencia.
program_terms.notes: General rule for every Visa M category, which includes the M Inversionista (art. 79). Valid from the resolution's entry into force (90 days after publication, 21 Oct 2022, per the header note).

program_terms.applies_to: children of the main visa holder who are economic dependants (beneficiaries; older children with a disability also qualify)
program_terms.quote: Beneficiario: O Titular Beneficiario, se refiere a los siguientes familiares siempre que sean dependientes económicos del titular principal de una visa el cónyuge o compañero{a) permanente; hijos hasta los 25 años de edad
program_terms.notes: General definition for all visas; art. 79 lets the M Inversionista holder apply for beneficiary visas under this definition.

program_terms.applies_to: Visa M Socio o Propietario: founding, stake in, or paid-in capital of a commercial company, or registered foreign investment, at the date of application
program_terms.quote: Acreditar constitución, participación, adquisición en capital pagado de sociedad comercial, o registro de la inversión extranjera, por un monto no inferior a cien (100) salarios mínimos mensuales legales vigentes, smmlv, a la fecha de presentación de la solicitud
program_terms.notes: Requirement 4 repeats the 100 smlmv floor for the applicant's own paid-in capital in share companies. Proposed programme; scope to be decided.

program_terms.applies_to: Visa M Socio o Propietario (maximum; conditional on keeping the stake)
program_terms.quote: Vigencia: hasta tres (3) años. La vigencia de la visa estará supeditada a que el monto de participación accionaria se mantenga durante la vigencia de la misma.

program_terms.applies_to: time as holder of Visa M Socio o Propietario before a Visa R by accumulated time

program_terms.notes: General rule for every Visa M category.

program_terms.applies_to: Visa M (incl. migrant visa as real-estate investor, art. 17 num. 10)
program_terms.quote: La visa tipo “M” tendrá vigencia de 3 años.
program_terms.notes: The resident visa for foreign direct investment (Visa R) had indefinite validity (art. 22).

program_terms.applies_to: continuous and uninterrupted stay as main holder of a Visa M under art. 17 num. 4-11 (incl. real-estate investor, num. 10) before a Visa R
program_terms.quote: Ha permanecido en el territorio nacional de forma continua e ininterrumpida por cinco (5) años en alguna de las siguientes condiciones: a) Como titular principal de visa tipo “M” en las condiciones de los numerales 4 al 11 del artículo 17.
program_terms.notes: Validity dates as on the existing rows from this resolution (in force 90 days after 2 Aug 2017; repealed from 20 Oct 2022).

program_terms.applies_to: continuous days abroad allowed during the qualifying period for a Visa R by accumulated time (real-estate investor visa holders)
program_terms.quote: se entenderá que el extranjero ha permanecido de forma continua si durante el periodo exigido no se ha ausentado del territorio nacional por más de 180 días continuos

program_terms.applies_to: Visa M holders and beneficiaries (incl. real-estate investor visa): continuous months abroad after which the visa expires
program_terms.quote: La visa Tipo “M” expira anticipadamente sin que medie pronunciamiento de la autoridad de visas cuando el titular principal o titular beneficiario permanece por seis meses continuos fuera del territorio nacional durante la vigencia de su visa.

program_terms.applies_to: Visa R holders and beneficiaries (incl. resident visa for foreign direct investment): continuous years abroad after which the visa expires
program_terms.quote: La visa Tipo “R” expira cuando el titular principal o titular beneficiario permanece por dos años continuos fuera del territorio nacional durante la vigencia de su visa.
program_terms.notes: The FDI investor route led directly to a Visa R (art. 21 num. 5, art. 57).

program_terms.applies_to: children of the main visa holder (under 25, or older with a disability preventing economic independence)
program_terms.quote: se entenderán como miembros del núcleo familiar del titular principal de una visa su cónyuge o compañero(a) permanente, sus padres cuando dependan económicamente de él, sus hijos menores de veinticinco (25) años
program_terms.notes: General rule for beneficiary visas of any main holder.

program_terms.applies_to: migrant visa as entrepreneur (art. 17 num. 6): capital acquired in a commercial company
program_terms.quote: el extranjero deberá adquirir capital en sociedad comercial por un monto no inferior a cien (100) salarios mínimos mensuales legales vigentes
program_terms.notes: Proposed programme; scope to be decided. For share companies the applicant's own registered and paid-in capital may not be below 100 smmlv (same article).

program_terms.applies_to: Visa M (incl. entrepreneur, art. 17 num. 6)

program_terms.applies_to: first permanent-residence-by-investment card (renewed at the end of the first year)
program_terms.quote: La Residencia Permanente por Inversión extranjera será renovada en el término del primer año, las demás renovaciones se harán por el término de cuatro (4) años.
program_terms.notes: Valid from the decree's signing date, as on the existing rows from this decree (publication date not in the stored copy). Text read from OCR. The year is written 'primer año' (no digit).

program_terms.applies_to: each renewal after the first year
program_terms.quote: las demás renovaciones se harán por el término de cuatro (4) años.
program_terms.notes: Valid from the decree's signing date, as on the existing rows from this decree (publication date not in the stored copy). Text read from OCR. Renewals after four years from the first card also need proof that the capital contributions (or the required average bank deposit) are maintained (art. 58, párrafo I).

program_terms.applies_to: continuous residence after obtaining permanent residence (any permanent resident, incl. the investor subcategory), before applying for naturalisation under Ley 1683
program_terms.quote: podrá optar por la naturalización luego de transcurridos dos (2) años de permanencia continua posterior a la obtención de la Residencia Permanente
program_terms.notes: Valid from the decree's signing date, as on the existing rows from this decree (publication date not in the stored copy). Text read from OCR. General naturalisation rule, kept as a context row without a programme (METHODOLOGY 15).

program_terms.applies_to: unmarried children counted as 'parientes' (adult children with a disability also qualify); investors' direct relatives benefit from the preferential regime (art. 56)
program_terms.quote: Pariente: Se refiere al cónyuge y a los hijos solteros menores de dieciocho (18) años de edad, o hijos mayores de edad discapacitados.
program_terms.notes: Valid from the decree's signing date, as on the existing rows from this decree (publication date not in the stored copy). Text read from OCR.

program_terms.applies_to: issue of the residence card after approval of a 'Permiso de Residencia a través de la Inversión' file
program_terms.quote: Se autorizará la emisión de un Carné de Residencia en un plazo máximo de cuarenta y cinco (45) días laborables, a partir de la fecha de recepción del expediente depurado.

program_terms.applies_to: applicants whose temporary or permanent residence is still being processed (incl. investors); beyond this, without justification, the application must be restarted
program_terms.quote: Un Extranjero en proceso de expedición de residencia temporal o permanente no podrá ausentarse del territorio nacional por períodos superiores a seis (6) meses.
program_terms.notes: Valid from the decree's signing date, as on the existing rows from this decree (publication date not in the stored copy). Text read from OCR.

program_terms.applies_to: first permanent-residence card (any permanent resident, incl. investors under art. 33(2))
program_terms.quote: A1 extranjero admitido como Residente Permanente se le otorgara un came de Residencia Permanente valido por un aiio.
program_terms.notes: The law states no entry-into-force date; valid from its publication in Gaceta Oficial No. 10291 of 27 Aug 2004 (date as cited in Decreto 631-11 and used for the programme's launch event; the stored copy does not print the Gaceta date). program_terms.applies_to: permanent-residence card after the first year, renewable for like periods
program_terms.quote: A1 termino de este period0 se le otorgara un Came valido por cuatro (4) aiios, renovable por periodos similares.
program_terms.notes: The law states no entry-into-force date; valid from its publication in Gaceta Oficial No. 10291 of 27 Aug 2004 (date as cited in Decreto 631-11 and used for the programme's launch event; the stored copy does not print the Gaceta date). program_terms.applies_to: lawful stay as permanent resident before a definitive residence card (carné de residencia definitiva), subject only to taxes
program_terms.quote: A todo extranjero que haya permanecido legalmente en el pais por un period0 de 10 aiios o mas como residente permanente, se le dotara de un carne de residencia definitiva
program_terms.notes: The law states no entry-into-force date; valid from its publication in Gaceta Oficial No. 10291 of 27 Aug 2004 (date as cited in Decreto 631-11 and used for the programme's launch event; the stored copy does not print the Gaceta date). Text layer reads 'period0', 'aiios'.

program_terms.applies_to: minimum term of the deposit title, policy or certificate (deposit option, art. 35(a))
program_terms.quote: Título, póliza o certificado de depósito a un plazo mínimo de setecientos treinta días (730) días
program_terms.notes: Valid from the regulation's publication (Registro Oficial Suplemento 55, 10 Aug 2017; Disposición Final: in force on publication). The consolidated text (to 17 Apr 2018) carries no amendment note on this article.

program_terms.applies_to: time as temporary resident (incl. investor) after which a permanent-residence application is made (stated in the rule on criminal-record certificates)
program_terms.quote: Para la solicitud de residencia permanente, la persona extranjera que haya permanecido en el Ecuador en calidad de residente temporal por dos (2) años, presentará el certificado de antecedentes penales
program_terms.notes: Valid from the regulation's publication (Registro Oficial Suplemento 55, 10 Aug 2017; Disposición Final: in force on publication). The consolidated text (to 17 Apr 2018) carries no amendment note on this article. The law itself sets 21 months (LOMH art. 63(1)).

program_terms.applies_to: naturalisation applicants: maximum days abroad per year during the first 3 years after the permanent-residence visa (more interrupts continuous residence)
program_terms.quote: podrán ausentarse del territorio ecuatoriano por un periodo máximo de ciento ochenta (180) días por año, durante los primeros tres (3) años, contados a partir de la emisión de la visa de residencia permanente.
program_terms.notes: Valid from the regulation's publication (Registro Oficial Suplemento 55, 10 Aug 2017; Disposición Final: in force on publication). program_terms.applies_to: temporary residence (incl. investor category, art. 60(4)), renewable once
program_terms.quote: Residencia temporal es la condición migratoria que autoriza la estadía de dos años en el territorio ecuatoriano, sujeta a renovación por una sola vez
program_terms.notes: Valid from the law's publication (RO Suplemento 938, 6 Feb 2017), the date it entered into force (Disposición Final), as on the programme's launch event.

program_terms.applies_to: time as temporary resident before permanent residence (application before the current status expires)
program_terms.quote: Cumplir al menos veintiún meses en calidad de residente temporal y presentar la solicitud correspondiente previo al vencimiento de la condición migratoria que ostenta
program_terms.notes: Valid from the law's publication (RO Suplemento 938, 6 Feb 2017), the date it entered into force (Disposición Final), as on the programme's launch event.

program_terms.applies_to: temporary residents: maximum days abroad per year, cumulative over the residence's validity (fine if exceeded)
program_terms.quote: La persona residente temporal podrá ausentarse del país por un periodo máximo de noventa días por cada año, acumulables dentro del periodo de vigencia de su residencia.
program_terms.notes: Valid from the law's publication (RO Suplemento 938, 6 Feb 2017), the date it entered into force (Disposición Final), as on the programme's launch event. Two absences beyond the limits are a ground for revoking the visa (art. 68).

program_terms.applies_to: permanent residents during the first two years: maximum days abroad in each year from obtaining the status (fine; status lost on repeat)
program_terms.quote: no podrá permanecer en el exterior más de ciento ochenta días en cada año contados desde la fecha de obtención de la condición migratoria, durante los dos primeros años.
program_terms.notes: Valid from the law's publication (RO Suplemento 938, 6 Feb 2017), the date it entered into force (Disposición Final), as on the programme's launch event.

program_terms.applies_to: permanent residents after the first two years: maximum absence before the residence is lost
program_terms.quote: La persona residente permanente, transcurridos los dos primeros años, podrá ausentarse del país hasta por cinco años. Pasado este tiempo perderá la residencia.
program_terms.notes: Valid from the law's publication (RO Suplemento 938, 6 Feb 2017), the date it entered into force (Disposición Final), as on the programme's launch event.

program_terms.applies_to: regular and continuous residence in Ecuador before applying for a carta de naturalización (general rule)
program_terms.quote: Las personas extranjeras que hayan residido de forma regular y continua al menos tres años en el Ecuador
program_terms.notes: Valid from the law's publication (RO Suplemento 938, 6 Feb 2017), the date it entered into force (Disposición Final), as on the programme's launch event. General naturalisation rule, kept as a context row without a programme (METHODOLOGY 15).

program_terms.applies_to: fine on a temporary resident absent more than 90 cumulative days per year
program_terms.quote: La persona residente temporal que se ausente por más de noventa días acumulables por cada año dentro del período de vigencia de su residencia será sancionada con una multa de tres salarios básicos unificados.
program_terms.notes: Valid from the law's publication (RO Suplemento 938, 6 Feb 2017), the date it entered into force (Disposición Final), as on the programme's launch event.

program_terms.applies_to: fine on a permanent resident absent more than 180 days in a year during the first two years (status lost on a repeat in the same period)
program_terms.quote: La persona residente permanente que se ausente más de ciento ochenta días en cada año contado desde la fecha obtención de su condición migratoria durante los dos primeros años, será sancionada con multa de cuatro salarios básicos unificados.
program_terms.notes: Valid from the law's publication (RO Suplemento 938, 6 Feb 2017), the date it entered into force (Disposición Final), as on the programme's launch event.

program_terms.applies_to: consecutive years in Honduras as resident (incl. investor) or special-permit holder, with the residence card renewed every year, before 'residente inmigrado' status
program_terms.quote: Haber permanecido en el país por un período no menor ele cinco (5) años consecutivos;

program_terms.applies_to: residence card of residents (incl. investors), renewed every year

events.description: Ley 28072, published 26 Sep 2003, amended the Aliens Law (DL 703): the 'Independiente' status, which had covered those entering to invest, to live on their income or to practise a profession independently, now covers only investors and independent professionals, and a separate 'Rentista' status with indefinite residence was added (arts. 11(p), 34). Date is the publication date printed in the compilation's notes; no entry-into-force date is given.
events.quote: (*) Inciso modificado por el Artículo 2 de la Ley N° 28072, publicada el 26-09-2003, cuyo texto es el siguiente: "n) Independiente.- Aquellos que ingresan al país para realizar inversiones o ejercer su profesión en forma independiente."

events.title: D.L. 531 adds loss of naturalisation for long absence and a minimum stay for temporary residents
events.description: D.L. 531 of 17 Mar 2026, published in D.O. No. 57 on 23 Mar 2026, amended the migration law: naturalised Salvadorans lose nationality after more than 2 consecutive years residing in their country of origin or more than 5 consecutive years abroad, unless permitted (art. 279); children under 18 born abroad before their parents' naturalisation can be considered Salvadoran (art. 164); temporary residents must stay at least 90 days a year (arts. 119, 72(5)). The compilation gives the publication date, not the entry-into-force date.

programs.name: Colombia migrant visa as company partner or owner (Visa M Socio o Propietario, Resolución 5477 de 2022 art. 75; under Resolución 6045 de 2017 art. 48: visa de migrante como empresario)
programs.notes: In scope under METHODOLOGY 15: the applicant's own minimum stake qualifies for the first visa by itself. The visa is granted for founding a company or buying a stake in a functioning one, with the applicant's own paid-in stake of at least 100 smmlv (Res. 5477 art. 75 req. 2 and 4; Res. 6045 art. 48). A minimum investment by itself qualifies for the first visa; from the second visa the company must show ongoing activity (art. 75 req. 3), and the work permit is limited to that company. Launch date not set: Res. 6045 of 2017 is the earliest stored text and itself replaced Res. 5512 of 2015 (not stored).

gaps: Scope decision needed: proposed programme col-business-partner-visa (Visa M Socio o Propietario / 2017 migrante como empresario, stake of at least 100 smmlv) under METHODOLOGY 15's business-route test.

ledger.contains: Colombian visa resolution 5477 of 2022 (in force 21 Oct 2022), compilation with amendments to Dec 2024: definitions, visitor (V), migrant (M) and resident (R) visas of all categories, procedures and terminations. In scope: M Inversionista (art. 79: FDI above 650 smlmv or real estate of at least 350 smlmv, validity up to 3 years), M Socio o Propietario (art. 75: stake of at least 100 smmlv, up to 3 years), Visa M absence rule (art. 65), beneficiary children up to 25 (art. 3), accumulated time for Visa R (art. 90 as modified 2023: 5 years for both), reporting duties (art. 84, no number). No fees in this resolution. Out of scope: other visa categories (pensioners, workers, digital nomads, students, etc.). This pass added: the 180-day absence rule and beneficiary age for the investor visa, a proposed programme for the M Socio o Propietario visa with its amount, validity, accumulated-time and absence rules (4 rules), and the 2023 amendment event.

Colombian visa resolution 6045 of 2017 (in force 90 days after 2 Aug 2017, repealed from 20 Oct 2022), compilation with notes: definitions, V, M and R visas of all categories, requirements, terminations. In scope: real-estate migrant visa (art. 52, at least 350 smmlv), resident visa for foreign direct investment (arts. 21(5), 57, above 650 smmlv; indefinite validity, art. 22), entrepreneur migrant visa (art. 48, capital of at least 100 smmlv), Visa M validity (art. 18), accumulated time for Visa R (art. 21), absence rules (arts. 21, 66), beneficiary children under 25 (art. 26). Art. 57 refers to 'numeral 6 del artículo 21' though the FDI condition is numeral 5. No fees. Out of scope: other visa categories. This pass added: validity, accumulated-time, absence and dependant-age rules for the investor visas (6 rules) and the entrepreneur visa amount, validity and accumulated time under the proposed programme col-business-partner-visa (3 rules).

English translation of Curaçao's Ministerial Decree of 26 Sep 2014 ('Richtlijnen Investors permit 2014', effective 1 Oct 2014, repealing the 2009 decree): Annex I conditions (business or real-property investment of ANG 500,000 / 750,000 / 1,500,000 for a 3-year, 5-year or indefinite permit; government fees and charges per permit; family members; refusal, extension, revocation; health insurance; security deposit by nationality with no amount stated; 2-week decision period; transitional rule; section 8 per-12-month-period fee schedule) and Annex II document lists (incl. ANG 10 revenue stamp per family member). The stored PDF repeats the decree text twice in its text layer. No statistics. This pass added: the section 8 per-period fees and charges (ANG 580/570 and 55/45), the charges of ANG 145/235/460 as their own rows, and the ANG 10 revenue stamp (8 rules). The security deposit has no amount in the document, so nothing to record.

Decreto 631-11 (signed 19 Oct 2011), the 144-article regulation of Migration Law 285-04 (72 pages, read from OCR): definitions, the National Migration Council, visas, residence categories and their documents, investors (arts. 53-58: Programa de Permiso de Residencia a través de la Inversión, US$200,000 minimum or an amount set by the Executive for designated projects, renewal after 1 year then every 4 years), pensioners and rentiers (arts. 59-66: US$1,500 / US$2,000 monthly income, US$250 per dependant; out of scope, income routes), temporary workers, non-residents, re-entry, deportation and prisoners. Fees are left to the Executive under law art. 140 (art. 144); none are set here. No statistics. This pass added: first-card validity and 4-year renewals for investors, the 2-year naturalisation period after permanent residence, the dependant age (under 18), the 45-working-day card issue period and the 6-month absence limit while an application is processed (6 rules).

Gaceta extract (48 pages, scanned with a text layer) with the end of the preceding law (promulgated 3 Aug 2004), the full Ley General de Migración 285-04 (154 articles; passed by the Senate 22 Jul and the Chamber 15 Aug 2004, promulgated 15 Aug 2004) and the start of Ley 286-04 on primary elections (out of scope). In scope: investors as permanent residents with the amount left to regulation (art. 33(2)), first card 1 year then 4-year renewable cards (art. 75), definitive residence card after 10 years (art. 46), fees to be set by decree (art. 140, no amounts), regulation within 180 days (art. 153). No amounts or statistics. This pass added: the card validity, renewal and 10-year definitive-residence rules (3 rules) and the promulgation event. Note: the ledger and source title say 'promulgada el 3 de agosto de 2004', which is the preceding law's date; Ley 285-04 was promulgated on 15 Aug 2004 (p. 43), and the existing launch event's description repeats the 3 Aug date.

Regulation of Ecuador's Organic Law on Human Mobility (Decreto Ejecutivo 111, signed 3 Aug 2017, RO Suplemento 55 of 10 Aug 2017, in force on publication), Lexis consolidation to 17 Apr 2018 (the text layer repeats the document twice): returning nationals, documents, visa categories and requirements (art. 35 investor: 730-day deposit of at least 70 SBU, property of at least 80 SBU, shares or own business of at least 70 SBU), revocation, criminal-record rules, diplomatic and humanitarian visas, naturalisation procedures (art. 66 absence limit), deportation. Fees are left to the consular tariff (no amounts). No statistics. This pass added: the 730-day deposit term, the 2-year temporary residence before permanent residence, and the naturalisation absence limit (3 rules). Note: the 3 existing art. 35 amount rows from this source have no valid_from; by this pass's reading they apply from 10 Aug 2017.

Registro Oficial Suplemento 938 (6 Feb 2017, 32 pages, two-column; the text layer holds the issue twice): Ley Orgánica de Movilidad Humana, in force on publication. Emigrants and returnees (incl. vehicle and household-goods exemptions in SBU, out of scope), foreigners' rights, temporary residence categories incl. investor (art. 60(4), 2 years renewable once), permanent residence after 21 months (art. 63), absence limits (art. 65), visas, naturalisation (3 years, art. 71-72), passports, protection, fees set by ministerial agreement (no amounts), migration offences and fines (art. 170), transitional provisions. No investment amounts (left to regulation) and no statistics. This pass added: temporary-residence validity, 21-month route to permanent residence, three absence limits, the 3-year naturalisation period and the two absence fines (8 rules).

La Gaceta No. 30,331 (3 Mar 2004, 19 pages, scanned; the text layer holds the issue twice): Decreto 208-2003, Ley de Migración y Extranjería (in force 60 days after publication). In scope: residence categories incl. investors (art. 21), investor residence (arts. 31-34: any lawful economic activity or state securities, minimum US$50,000), residente inmigrado after 5 consecutive years with annual card renewal (art. 37), loss of residence after 12 months abroad (art. 58), investor visas left to regulation (art. 76), fees left to the regulation (art. 92, no amounts), entry into force (art. 114). Out of scope: rentistas (US$2,500/month) and pensioners (US$1,500/month), household-goods and vehicle exemptions, refugees, naturalisation (residence period set by the Constitution, no number here), passports, transport, sanctions. No statistics. This pass added: the 5-year route to residente inmigrado, annual card renewal and the 12-month absence limit (3 rules).

Two-page requirements list for investor residence (Reglamento de la Ley de Migración y Extranjería arts. 22, 33 and 35), 17 items: application, Lps.100 stamps per applicant, documents (medical certificate within 6 months, criminal records, passport), investment of at least US$50,000, feasibility study, US$5,000 deposit certificate at the Banco Central as guarantee, investor registry, $300 fee (art. 126 of the regulation). The text layer repeats the list twice. No statistics. This pass added: the Lps.100 stamp duty per applicant (1 rule).

La Gaceta No. 125 (6 Jul 2011, 44 pages; the text layer holds the issue twice): first part of Ley 761, Ley General de Migración y Extranjería (arts. 1 to about 120): migration authority, entry, residence categories (temporary residents 1-3 years; permanent subcategories incl. 'inmigrante con capital', art. 30), pensioner/rentier residence under Ley 694 (out of scope), investor immigrant determined by MIFIC certificate with requirements left to regulation (art. 32), investor residence through capital in any lawful activity or state securities (art. 35, no amount), revocation incl. absence limits (art. 38), nationality (art. 53: 4 years with renunciation; art. 54: 2 years for Spaniards and Central Americans; art. 55: 2 years for investor residents; art. 57: extension to children under 21), passports and visas. Also unrelated notices (procurement awards in US$, trademarks, association statutes), out of scope. No investment amounts or statistics. This pass added: the 1-year absence limit for permanent residents and the age limit for children to whom nationality extends (2 rules). The rest of the law (fees, deposits, entry into force) is in Gaceta 126 (nic-gaceta-126-2011-ley-761).

La Gaceta No. 126 (7 Jul 2011, 44 pages; the text layer holds the issue twice): second part of Ley 761 (arts. 121-224): fee tables for nationals (art. 121) and foreigners (art. 122, amounts printed in C$ though the article says US dollars or equivalent), guarantee deposit equal to a return ticket (arts. 128-135, no amount), transport, employers, hotels, fines, detention, deportation and expulsion, appeals, the migration service career, repeals of the 1993 laws (art. 222) and entry into force 30 days after publication (art. 224). Also unrelated items (IDA financing decree, cooperatives, tenders), out of scope. No statistics and no investment amounts. This pass added: residence form, revalidation, 5-year permanent residence card fee and validity, nationality application, family-extension and certificate fees (7 rules). Fines for irregular stay, lost cards and the visa and certificate fees not tied to residence or nationality were not tabled (general services, not investor-route terms).

La Gaceta No. 80 (30 Apr 1993, 24 pages; the text layer holds the issue twice): Ley 153, Ley de Migración (signed 24 Feb, promulgated 22 Apr 1993, in force 30 days after publication, art. 75; repeals Decreto 1031 of 1982, art. 74): permanent-resident subcategories incl. 'inmigrante con capital' (arts. 10, 14-21: own assets for activities in any sector, investment plan reviewed by the Ministry of Economy, or purchase of public securities; no amount), rentistas and pensioners (arts. 22-27; art. 25 assimilates to rentistas those who deposit state bonds at the Central Bank for at least 5 years), temporary residents, visas, fines on transport companies (up to C$50,000 and C$5,000, out of scope). Also unrelated notices (appointments, cooperative statutes, trademarks). No amounts for investors and no statistics. This pass added: the 5-year bond deposit term of the rentista-assimilation route (1 rule).

Gaceta Oficial 26104 (13 Aug 2008), 89 pages with a text layer. Out of scope: DE 25 of 2007 on an agricultural trust programme (pp. 1-10), Resolution 47/08 and land-title edicts at the end. Main content: Decreto Ejecutivo 320 of 8 Aug 2008, the regulation of the migration law (Decreto Ley 3 of 2008): visas, temporary and permanent residence categories, fees and sanctions. In scope and in tables: Solvencia Económica Propia (arts. 191-195) and macro-enterprise investor (arts. 185-190) with dependant amounts, employees and art. 315 fees; agrarian investor (arts. 95-97), forestry investor temporary (arts. 100-102) and permanent (arts. 180-182), Panamá-Pacífico investor (arts. 206-207), export processing zone investor (art. 211) and call-centre investor (art. 214), with the art. 315 fee rows that apply to each, launch events for five categories and legal-basis events for four (Ley 25 of 1992, DE 97 of 2002, Ley 41 of 2004, Decreto Ley 6 of 1999); City of Knowledge businessperson or executive subcategory (arts. 108, 113; no investment amount); film and audiovisual industry investor (arts. 217-219, more than B/.150,000; art. 315 fees B/.250 and B/.100). Added in pass extract-partials-p2-2026-10-11: for the City of Knowledge permit, the 6-year maximum of temporary special-policy permits renewable annually (art. 105) and the B/.50 card fee from the art. 315 row for temporary permits 'por políticas especiales' (2 rules). Out of scope: pensioners, Rentista Retirado (arts. 196-197; decision 15), film company staff permits (arts. 106-107), the short-stay visa for traders and investors under special laws (arts. 54-55), workers' minimum salaries, visa fees. No statistics.

Decreto Legislativo 703, Ley de Extranjería (promulgated 5 Nov 1991, in force on the 30th day), compilation with later amendments (Ley 28072 of 2003 and others), 19 pages: entry, visa types and migration statuses (art. 11(n) 'Independiente' for investors), temporary and residence periods (arts. 33-34), exit and re-entry, refugees, rights and obligations, sanctions, transitional provisions. Rentistas (US$1,000 monthly income plus US$500 per dependant; 6-month absence limit) are out of scope (income route). No investment amounts, fees or statistics. This pass added: the 1-year renewable residence and 90-day temporary visa of the Independiente status (2 rules, valid to 28 Feb 2017 when DL 1350 replaced the law) and the 2003 amendment event.

BACN web record of Ley 6984 'De Migraciones' (promulgated 17 Oct, published 18 Oct 2022; no entry-into-force clause): principles, entry categories, non-residents (90 days), temporary residence (2 years, prerequisite for permanent residence except for investors under the SUACE law, art. 46), permanent residence requirements incl. proof of investment (art. 52), loss after 3 years' absence (arts. 54, 62), card renewal every 10 years (art. 59), expulsion, the Dirección Nacional de Migraciones, fines in jornales (arts. 87-97), fee schedule in jornales (art. 100), repeal of Ley 978/1996 (art. 107). No amounts in guaraníes or statistics. This pass added: permanent-residence, change-of-category, card-renewal and certificate fees, the 10-year card and the 3-year absence limit (6 rules). Fines on transport companies and employers and fees for other residence types were not tabled (not investor-route terms).

BACN web record of Ley 978 'De Migraciones' (passed 3 Oct, promulgated 8 Nov 1996): admission categories; permanent residents incl. immigrants with capital and investors (arts. 14, 17-18; minimum amounts left to regulation, art. 20), family extension (art. 21), loss after 3 years' absence (art. 24), non-resident investors (art. 29(7)), temporary residence periods, cancellation within 3 years for investors who do not meet their obligations (art. 34(3)), expulsion, immigration with capital policy (arts. 125-131), repatriates' import allowances in jornales (out of scope), the Dirección General de Migraciones, fee schedule in daily minimum wages (art. 152). No amounts in money or statistics. This pass added: permanent-residence, change-of-category and certificate fees, the 3-year absence limit and the 3-year cancellation window for investors (5 rules).

SUACE operational guide for foreign investors (MIC, May 2025, 12 pages; the text layer repeats it): Paraguay pitch, SUACE institutions, step 1 Constancia de Inversionista (USD 70,000 within two years, 5 formal jobs, documents), step 2 permanent residence as investor (10 years renewable, documents, fee table: permanent residence incl. change of category Gs. 2.690.675, overstay fine Gs. 645.762, residence certificate Gs. 215.254), step 3 identity card, step 4 company types (EAS, S.A., SRL: no minimum capital, registration times; company law, out of scope), step 5 investment incentives (the list of regimes on p. 10 is not in the text layer; tax incentives are out of scope), contacts. No statistics. This pass added: the 2-year investment deadline, the 5-job commitment, the residence certificate fee and the overstay fine (4 rules).

Consolidated Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería (D.L. 286 of 2019, in force 20 days after publication on 25 Apr 2019) with reforms to D.L. 531 of 2026 (Supreme Court compilation, 101 pages; the text layer repeats it): visas incl. investor/business visa (no residence), non-residents, investor definition (art. 90: shareholders, directors, managers of companies with active investment; no minimum amount), temporary residence for investors (art. 109(1), up to 2 years) and 90-day minimum stay (art. 119), permanent residence (art. 152 incl. (13) direct residence for government-programme participants), refrenda up to 4 years (art. 153), absence (art. 154), nationality (arts. 155-156 incl. (5) investors and donors; art. 164 children; art. 279 loss), fees (art. 325), repeals and entry into force. No statistics. This pass added: naturalisation fee, four permanent-residence renewal fees, 4-year renewal limit, child age, two absence rules for naturalised citizens (9 rules on the programme), four general nationality periods as context rows without a programme, and the D.L. 531 (2026) event. Not tabled: the investor visa (USD 200) and frequent-traveller card (USD 150), which give no residence (art. 92), and the temporary residence for company investors (art. 109(1)), which needs no minimum investment (art. 90) and so falls outside METHODOLOGY 15; other fees are general services.

Diario Oficial No. 5, Tomo 442 (9 Jan 2024), 292 pages: Decreto 918 (pp. 4-5, scanned, read by OCR) reforming art. 156 of the migration law to add naturalisation for investors and donors in government programmes (art. 156(5)), in force 8 days after publication; its recitals cite the 2019 law's publication (D.O. 75, 25 Apr 2019) and the Bitcoin Law. The rest of the issue is out of scope: other decrees, ministry resolutions incl. individual nationality grants (named private persons, not recorded), court notices, land and company edicts. No amounts or statistics. This pass added: the three residence periods restated in the reformed art. 156(1)-(3), as context rows without a programme (3 rules). The publication and entry-into-force events were already recorded.
